escalation_faqs.question: What triggers an L3 CEO Escalation?
escalation_faqs.answer: L3 escalations are triggered by claim disputes exceeding $10,000, allegations of compliance breaches, complex multi-insurance portfolios, or Platinum VIP status issues.

escalation_faqs.question: How long does Sri AI take to resolve an escalation?
escalation_faqs.answer: Under our executive service level rules, Sri AI resolves L3 escalations within 15 minutes of trigger.
